$comment: Declared versions NOT published from this repository, each with the reason.
State is computed from this repository's git tags. a1 and a2 were published
from dotmac_starter_mt and their tags stay there permanently.
0.1.0a3 is published and permanently unpinnable; 0.1.0a4 is published,
independently verified, and refused for adoption. Neither is an unpublished
declaration, so neither belongs here — `docs/published-versions.json` is
where both live, and a4's superseding disposition is appended to its
original PASS record there rather than replacing it.
The a4 row that used to sit here said `never-published` and outlived its own
publication by six hours. That is the stale absolution the two-directional
ratchet in test_ported_gate_declared_publication.py exists to catch, and it
did not catch it: CI checked out without tags, so the gate could not see the
tag that contradicted this file. Both halves are fixed together — the row is
gone and the checkout now fetches tags.
0.1.0a5 sits here for the ONLY correct reason a row belongs in this file: it
is declared in pyproject.toml and nothing has been published under that name
yet. It is NOT in docs/published-versions.json, and that is deliberate — the
release floor is derived as the maximum of the rows in that file, so
recording a5 there before it exists would raise the floor above the version
being published and the release guard would refuse the release it is meant
to admit. The row moves in the same change that records the real
coordinates, and this one is deleted then.

0.1.0a5.reason: Cut on Michael's ruling of 2026-08-30 that 0.1.0a4 is immutable and identity-verified but UNADOPTABLE. a5 carries the Control-owned `PlanDigestV1` value type (algorithm plus digest bytes, canonical `sha256:<64 lowercase hex>`, compared typed and never as a string), the separation of `DigestEncodingError` from `ApprovalRefusedError` so a formatting fault can no longer be reported as a changed plan, a4's bare-hex form accepted only through the explicitly named legacy parser INSIDE Control, and `__version__` derived from the installed distribution's metadata so one literal version authority remains. Publication is owed: dispatch Release, then Verify release, and only that second run may write the tag.
owed: dispatch `Release` with distribution=dotmac-deployment-control version=0.1.0a5 from the exact tip of protected main
dispatch `Verify release` with version=0.1.0a5 and the release run id; only a VERIFIED verdict writes the tag
record the coordinates and both sha256 digests in docs/published-versions.json, move the release floor to a5, move the positive control to a6, and delete this row
